scope: Sleek:Jumped official preset listing demo inspected read-only via rendered browser accessibility trees. No shopper actions, screenshot, viewport, mobile, editor, checkout or performance testing.

sources.observation: Official Shopify Sleek Jumped preset listing and embedded View demo opened the Sleek Jumped storefront.

claims.observed: Rendered catalog includes five facet groups, sorting, card actions and pagination; Zenith Shirt PDP provides size variants and regional measurement table.
claims.risk: Visible controls do not prove their behavior or that size/stock data and fit guidance are accurate.
claims.vsn_guard: Test filter and variant behavior and validate size charts against merchant product data.

claims.observed: Home and PDP include story and promotional modules, but sample copy references product categories that do not match the products shown.
claims.risk: Template sample copy can be mistaken for product-specific truth; sustainability, delivery, discount, inventory and reviews are unverified.
claims.vsn_guard: Audit page-to-product content mapping and require evidence for merchant claims before launch.
